# C S R VedVikas — personal portfolio

Static portfolio of C S R VedVikas, final-year B.Tech Electronics and Communication Engineering student with a minor in Computer Science at PES University, Bengaluru. He builds full-stack web applications and works on applied machine learning, security, hardware verification and antenna design.

- /: intro, selected work, credentials, contact.
- /forgefit: case study on ForgeFit, a full-stack fitness PWA built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL and React 19.
- /playbook: case study on the Cursor AI Beginner Playbook, a single-file HTML teaching artifact with an in-browser CNN.
